name: peek
description: Draws a small preview of each image pasted into the prompt, above the prompt box, so you can see it is the right one before you send it. Open under a preview shows the picture itself in a small window. Plain code: it makes no model calls.

enabled.title: Peek
enabled.description: Preview the images pasted into the prompt.

columns.title: Preview width (columns)
columns.description: How wide a preview may be drawn, in terminal columns.
